hero.subline: packbar is the packing list you check off: with a 220-item template, made for sharing, printed cleanly at the end.

demo.title: Checking off feels good
demo.text: Every list is a boarding pass for your trip: categories, items, progress. What's in the suitcase gets checked off, the rest stays visible.
demo.hint: Click the boxes, this card is real.

features.title: Everything for the list, nothing around it

template.title: 220-item template
template.text: Don't start from zero: the default template covers everything from passport to power bank. Crossing off is faster than remembering.

share.title: Share & pack together
share.text: One link is enough: whoever gets it sees the list and checks things off, no account needed.
share.meta: By link · View or pack along

presets.title: Presets for trip types
presets.text: Beach, city break or mountains: start lists from fitting templates and build your own for the next trip.

print.title: Print view
print.text: Paper at the end: the list comes out of the printer cleanly formatted and travels along as a sheet.

covers.title: From road trip to winter holiday
